decisions.reason: As a newly launched complement to the firm’s web-service business, it is still within the trial phase and its low-cost, related nature makes management likely to keep it unless clear underperformance emerges.
A responsive website template fits closely with the firm’s existing capabilities, so under behavioral decision-making it would usually be retained while early market feedback remains uncertain.

Premium customer support is easy to bundle with established services and needs limited extra resources, so a medium-sized firm would typically continue it unless results quickly fall below aspiration levels.
Its dedicated product page suggests a stronger strategic commitment, and with no visible evidence of failure management would likely give this software tool more time to prove itself.

The dedicated page indicates meaningful commitment and the product addresses a practical business need, so boundedly rational management would usually keep it on the market while learning about demand.
